items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That's what Pompolain does. [INTERVIEWEE] He said he was the best in the city... He played nice trombone.

ctx.x: Was he good trombone? Daddy? He's the only one who played a Valtrombone player. He played trombone. He played trombone. Yeah.

He said he was the best in the city. Layouts. He died. Oh, yeah. He played nice trombone. He died a long time. Yeah, but he could pop a Valtrombone player like anybody did. Make it sound like a swat. He could. All through. Bill.
